# Pumpkin curry with chickpeas
- [Barney Desmazery](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/author/barneydesmazery)

**
**
**Serves 4**
**Easy**
Prep: **20 mins**
Cook: **20 mins**

## Ingredients
## Nutrition
Units:
- 1 tbsp [sunflower oil](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/glossary/sunflower-oil-glossary)
- 3 tbsp Thai yellow curry paste
  or vegetarian alternative
- 2 [onions](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/glossary/onion-glossary)
  finely chopped
- 3 [large stalks lemongrass](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/glossary/lemon-grass-glossary)
  bashed with the back of a knife
- 6 cardamom pods
- 1 tbsp mustard seed
- 1 [piece pumpkin](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/glossary/pumpkin-glossary)
  or a small squash (about 1kg)
- 250ml vegetable stock
- 400ml [can reduced-fat coconut milk](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/glossary/coconut-milk-glossary)
- 400g can chickpea
  drained and rinsed
- 2 [limes](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/glossary/lime-glossary)
- [large handful mint](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/glossary/mint-glossary)
  leaves
- naan bread
  to serve

Keep the screen awake with cook mode on the [Good Food app.](https://immediate.onelink.me/OQap?af_xp=custom&pid=website&c=ingredients_CTA&is_retargeting=true&af_reengagement_window=30d&af_dp=bbcgoodfood%3A%2F%2F)

## Method
- ### step 1
  Heat the oil in a sauté pan, then gently fry the curry paste with the onions, lemongrass, cardamom and mustard seed for 2-3 mins until fragrant. Stir the pumpkin or squash into the pan and coat in the paste, then pour in the stock and coconut milk. Bring everything to a simmer, add the chickpeas, then cook for about 10 mins until the pumpkin is tender. The curry can now be cooled and frozen for up to 1 month.
- ### step 2
  Squeeze the juice of one lime into the curry, then cut the other lime into wedges to serve alongside. Just before serving, tear over mint leaves, then bring to the table with the lime wedges and warm naan breads.
